name: Candlelight: Best of Bridgerton
description: Experience the romance and drama of the hit series through its iconic score, performed live by a string quartet in a stunning venue illuminated by thousands of candles.
longDescription:
Candlelight: Best of Bridgerton presents a musical evening dedicated to the popular television series. This event features a string quartet performing selections from the show's soundtrack. The Candlelight series, known for its atmospheric concerts, aims to bring classical and contemporary music to a wider audience through unique settings.

Attendees will find themselves in the grand ballroom of the Hilton Porto Gaia, which will be illuminated by a multitude of candles. The performance offers a refined and immersive atmosphere, allowing the audience to engage with the familiar melodies in a new context. The concert is designed for fans of the series and those who appreciate instrumental music in an elegant setting.

This is a ticketed event scheduled for May 2, 2026. The Hilton Porto Gaia is located in Vila Nova de Gaia, accessible from central Porto. Specific public transport routes will be available closer to the date.
